boundary: New private privacy module, exact name subject to root assignment; additive migration after actual current chain. No historical migration rewrite.

proposed_tables.name: collect_privacy.subject_principals
proposed_tables.purpose: Stable justified retained principal with separate removable live Auth association and server-owned lifecycle state.
constraints: Existing financial/member UUIDs and Collect-ID reservations retain meaning.
Map actual effective FK graph; reviewed reference migration required.
Direct API grants absent; no auth.uid-only route may expose restricted retained profiles.

proposed_tables.name: collect_privacy.requests
proposed_tables.purpose: Verified scoped subject request and idempotent intake.
constraints: Same UUID/subject/scope hash returns same receipt; conflict refuses.
Equivalent active scope is linked or reused under subject lock.
Do not store identity documents or plaintext receipt copies.

proposed_tables.name: collect_privacy.retention_policies
constraints: No fabricated default horizon.
Missing approval/eligibility refuses destructive phase.

proposed_tables.name: collect_privacy.legal_holds
proposed_tables.purpose: Exact retained scope and audited release.
constraints: Recheck under row locks before each mutation.
Hold does not silently exempt unrelated eligible fields.

proposed_tables.name: collect_privacy.subject_assets
proposed_tables.purpose: Verified many-to-many subject/field relationship and lineage.
constraints: Uploading actor/receiver is not automatically the subject of all content.
Ambiguous name/last-three/hash matches require review; no destructive approximate match.

proposed_tables.name: collect_privacy.manifest_items
constraints: No raw body/document duplication in manifest.
Source or policy drift requires refusal/replan; no silent scope expansion.

proposed_tables.name: collect_privacy.execution_claims
constraints: Dedicated executor, no broad service-role table write grants.
Ordered locking aligned with existing SID/authority/source locks.
Measured item/time/resource bounds; no unbounded loop.
Lost acknowledgement resumes from recorded outcome.

proposed_tables.name: collect_privacy.disposition_receipts
proposed_tables.purpose: Append-only minimized evidence of actual results.
constraints: No original PII/body included.
Failed/skipped/missing result cannot satisfy completed scope.

proposed_tables.name: collect_privacy.copy_jobs
constraints: Provider ACK is not deletion proof.
Offline device, uncertain transmission and inaccessible export remain outstanding.
Do not erase shared keys protecting justified retained material.

proposed_tables.name: collect_privacy.restore_tombstones
proposed_tables.purpose: Durable minimal exclusion applied before restored data is exposed.
constraints: Independent of restoring an older database snapshot.
Reapply before access, ingest, parser, dispatch or provider workers resume.
Tombstones remain personal/linkable and require purpose/access policy.

proposed_apis.name: request_privacy_lifecycle_v1
proposed_apis.caller: verified live subject or governed assisted verifier
proposed_apis.contract: Bounded request UUID/kind/scope/hash/expected revision/reason code; subject derived from trusted identity; replay exact request, conflict changed payload; return safe status receipt.

proposed_apis.name: get_privacy_request_status_v1
proposed_apis.contract: Return only own safe stage, dispositions, justified retained grounds and outstanding copies; no internal customer body or other subject identity.

proposed_apis.name: claim_privacy_phase_v1
proposed_apis.contract: Validated bounded item/time budget, ordered locks, policy/hold/source recheck and current lease/fence; return minimum exact items.

proposed_apis.name: redact_privacy_manifest_item_v1
proposed_apis.contract: Actual locked request/manifest authority; exact columns only; reject ordinary role, forged GUC and non-current claim. Preserve origin/dedup/financial/dispatch proof per approved basis.

proposed_apis.name: record_privacy_copy_outcome_v1
proposed_apis.contract: Bind exact child idempotency key, object/device/processor scope and actual confirmation; uncertain outcome stays pending.

proposed_apis.name: verify_privacy_scope_completion_v1
proposed_apis.contract: Fail on incomplete items/copies/source drift; return scoped eligible-erasure confirmation and separately listed justified retention; never infer completion from pending request or timeout.

authority_limits: No backend source edited in discovery.
No new legal horizon, policy approval, human owner or provider permission assigned.
Actual effective catalog and current source closure required before implementation.
Root must coordinate live writers and explicitly assign each write boundary.
